:::{#cor-self-outer-product-rank}
#### A self outer product has rank one

For a nonzero vector $\vx$,
the [self outer product](#def-self-outer-product) $\soprod{\vx}$
has [rank](linear-algebra.qmd#def-rank) $1$:

$$
\rankf{\soprod{\vx}} = 1
$$

:::

::: proof

The self outer product $\soprod{\vx}$ is the [outer product](#def-outer-product) $\oprod{\vx}{\vx}$.
Both of its factors are the nonzero vector $\vx$,
so @thm-outer-product-rank,
with $\vx$ in place of both $\vecf{u}$ and $\vecf{v}$,
gives [rank](linear-algebra.qmd#def-rank) $1$.

:::
